# Generated by scripts/generate_raw_material_local_map_modes.py - do not edit by hand.
# Static planning values for the raw-material output map modes.
# Total map value = the location's local_<good>_output_modifier as the engine sums it
# (attribute rows from the World Builder, the RGO base and floor, the RGO bonus).
# The attribute part is the total minus the active raw-material RGO bonus.

pp_beeswax_productivity_map_value = {
	value = modifier:local_beeswax_output_modifier
}

pp_beeswax_productivity_location_potential_map_value = {
	value = modifier:local_beeswax_output_modifier
	if = {
		limit = { raw_material = goods:beeswax }
		subtract = 0.20
	}
}

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { raw_material = goods:beeswax }
		add = 0.20
	}
}

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { raw_material = goods:lead }
		add = 0.20
	}
}
